examples.english: My mother and father were also happy.
examples.transliteration: Ommi w abi kaman kanu mabsooteen.

examples.arabic: أهل الحارة كمان سمعوا بالقصة، وكتير منهم عرضوا مساعدتهن، حبًا بأبو كريم.
examples.english: The neighborhood folk also heard about the story, and many of them offered their help, out of love for Abu Karim.
examples.transliteration: Ahl il-Haret kaman sami'u bil-qiSSah, w-kteer min-hom 'araDu musa'adit-hon, Hubban bi-Abu Karim.

examples.arabic: خلال نقاشهم، انضمت إليهم صديقتهم ليلى، وقالت: "أهلي بيحكوا إنه من عشر سنين كانت الأوضاع أصعب بكثير، بس كمان ما شفنا تغيير حقيقي."
examples.english: During their discussion, their friend Layla joined them and said: "My parents say that ten years ago, conditions were much harder, but we also haven't seen real change."
examples.transliteration: Khilal naqashihim, indhammat ilayhim sadeeqatihim Layla, w qaalt: "Ahli biyḥku inno min 'ashar sneen kanat el-awdha'a as'ab bi-kteer, bas kaman ma shufna taghyeer ḥaqeeqi."
examples.storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

examples.arabic: الصبايا والشباب كمان شاركوا بطموحاتٍ كبيرة، وعرضوا أفكار خلاقة لدعم المجتمع.
examples.english: Young men and women also participated with great aspirations, presenting creative ideas to support the community.
examples.transliteration: Es-sabaya w esh-shabab kaman sharku b-watuumuuhat kbeereh, w aradu afkar khallaqe la-da'm el mujtama'.

examples.english: I asked him "Are you also going to work?"
examples.transliteration: Sa'alto inta kamaan rayeh a'al ash-shoghl?

examples.arabic: مبروك حبيبتي بس احنا كمان مبسوطين عم نجهز للعرس الجديد بالعيلة
examples.english: Congratulations, my dear! But we are also happy, we are preparing for the new wedding in the family.
examples.transliteration: Mabrook habibti! Bas ihna kamaan mabsooteen, am njehhez lil-ers il-jdeed bil-a'ileh.
examples.storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family
